subject: Mythology
title: The Prometheus Myth in Technology
description: A quick, practical guide to The Prometheus Myth in Technology.

hook.text: Prometheus stole fire from the gods and gave it to humanity, changing everything. He was punished eternally for it.

buildup.text: Mary Shelley's Frankenstein was subtitled 'The Modern Prometheus' — a scientist who creates life and faces consequences.

discovery.text: Every debate about nuclear power, genetic engineering, and AI echoes Prometheus: power stolen, consequences suffered.

twist.text: Oppenheimer quoted Hindu mythology after building the atomic bomb: 'I am become Death.' Science keeps reliving myth.

climax.text: AI researchers openly discuss 'Promethean risk' — the danger of creating something smarter than its creator.

punchline.text: We keep stealing fire from the gods and keep being surprised when it burns.

quiz.question: Why do scientists reference the Prometheus myth in debates about technology?
options: Because Prometheus invented the first tools in Greek mythology
Because it warns about the consequences of gaining powerful knowledge that changes humanity
Because Prometheus was a scientist in the original Greek myth
